assumptions: The audience prefers a concise operating framework.

slides.title: A repeatable review rhythm
slides.subtitle: A simple structure for turning signals into clear next actions.

slides.title: Make context visible before making decisions
slides.subtitle: Two habits keep every review focused and actionable.

items.label: CONTEXT
items.title: Share the same view
items.body: Bring the current signal, constraint, and owner into one review surface.

items.label: ACTION
items.title: Close with ownership
items.body: Record one next action, one accountable owner, and one review moment.

callout.body: If the next action is unclear, the review is not finished.
